groupOrder: Shipping lanes (7-day average of daily transits)

indicators.label: Euro-area consumer prices, year on year
indicators.what: Change in the harmonised price index over 12 months, calculated from the published index. Monthly.

indicators.label: Ireland unemployment rate
indicators.what: Monthly harmonised rate. Published about three months behind.

indicators.label: US company shares, value as % of GDP
indicators.source: Federal Reserve Z.1 and US BEA (via FRED)
indicators.what: Market value of US non-financial company shares divided by annualised GDP. A version of the market-value-to-GDP gauge. Quarterly, published about three months behind.

indicators.label: US 3-month Treasury bill yield
indicators.what: What cash earns in short US government paper.

indicators.label: US 10-year real yield
indicators.what: Yield on 10-year inflation-protected Treasuries: the return after inflation on safe long-term money.

indicators.label: US 30-year mortgage rate
indicators.what: Average rate on a new 30-year fixed mortgage, weekly.

indicators.label: US consumer sentiment
indicators.what: Monthly household survey index. Published about a month behind.

indicators.label: US industrial production
indicators.what: Output of factories, mines and utilities. Monthly.

indicators.label: US retail sales
indicators.what: Retail and food-service sales, seasonally adjusted. Monthly.

indicators.label: US rail freight carloads
indicators.source: US Bureau of Transportation Statistics (via FRED)
indicators.what: Goods moved by rail, seasonally adjusted. Monthly, about three months behind.

recordSources.label: Company filings
recordSources.what: 8-K, 6-K, 10-Q and 10-K filings for a watchlist of large companies, including non-US companies that file in the US.

recordSources.label: Company press releases
recordSources.what: The company's own announcements. Logged as the company's statement.

recordSources.label: China official statistics
recordSources.source: National Bureau of Statistics of China
recordSources.what: Prices, PMI, GDP and industrial releases.

recordSources.label: Euro-area official statistics
recordSources.what: Inflation, production, trade, debt and deficit releases.

recordSources.label: Scheduled decisions and releases
recordSources.source: Fed, ECB, Bank of England, BLS

stories.title: China and Japan: official data and central-bank decisions
stories.what: Releases from China's National Bureau of Statistics and statements from the Bank of Japan.

stories.title: Large-company disclosures
stories.what: Regulatory filings and official press releases from a watchlist of large listed companies. Company statements are the company's own account.

stories.title: Euro-area, Irish and UK rates and inflation
stories.what: ECB and Bank of England policy rates, euro-area consumer prices and Irish unemployment.

stories.title: Strait of Hormuz and Gulf shipping
stories.what: Ship transits through the Strait of Hormuz and official maritime security reporting for the Gulf region.

stories.title: Middle East airspace restrictions
stories.what: EASA conflict-zone bulletins covering Iran, the Gulf and neighbouring airspace: when issued, revised and due to expire.

stories.title: Oil and fuel prices
stories.what: Brent crude, US natural gas and US gasoline prices as published by the US Energy Information Administration.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine
stories.what: Official statements and measures about the war in Ukraine

stories.title: Stock markets
stories.what: Closing levels of the S&P 500, Nasdaq Composite and Nikkei 225, and the VIX volatility index.

stories.title: US interest rates, inflation and credit
stories.what: The Federal Reserve's policy rate, Treasury yields, consumer-price inflation and the high-yield credit spread.

stories.title: US sanctions actions on Iran
stories.what: Iran-related designations, licences and alerts published by the US Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control.
